tasks.title: Fix pricing.ts discount bug
tasks.brief: Project: /tmp/v3orch/w/t2 (node project, TypeScript, tests via `npm test`). Fix exactly one bug in src/pricing.ts so that applyDiscount matches its doc comment: `pct is a whole percentage: applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900`. Currently applyDiscount does `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct))`, which treats pct as a fraction, so 10 gives a negative number. Fix it by converting the whole percentage to a fraction (e.g. `1 - pct / 100`). Edit only src/pricing.ts. Do NOT edit any test file or any other file. Do not special-case tests. Keep the rest of the file unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix inventory.ts reserve bug
tasks.brief: Project: /tmp/v3orch/w/t2 (node project, TypeScript, tests via `npm test`).
